reference_check: reports/ANALYSIS_REFERENCE_MAP.md; original author analyses inspected before launch

hpcs.question: Do deposited cell-type labels reproduce the explicit author map, and how much of classifier disagreement is confidence abstention?
hpcs.scope: Map validation over all deposited rows and the original 5333 traced cells; confidence abstention summaries by RNA state, source and group; retain all cells in denominators
hpcs.stopping_rule: If stringent labels retain the original code or other only, retire independent-classifier interpretation; do not force K12 codes into the newleiden map
hpcs.inference: Descriptive audit only; probabilities absent so no independent recalculation of the 0.8 confidence threshold

cd44.precedent: Rodriguez et al. 2025 Fig. 3e-k, GSE273123 paired CD44Hi/Lo from four mice per genotype; edgeR QL workflow Chen/Lun/Smyth 2016; existing local scripts 04 and 08
cd44.identity_rule: Join submitted SRA Original FASTQ filenames to count identifiers by source token and CD44 gate. Only spelling normalization R26_1 -> R261 (likewise 2,7,8); no ordering or expression-based identity inference. Require a bijection and concordant GEO title/genotype/sort; positive and negative must share mouse label.
cd44.samples: All 16 libraries; four paired WT mice and four paired SP-C mutant mice; no outlier exclusions
cd44.model: ~0 + mouse + positiveWT + positiveMutant; genotype main effect is absorbed by mouse
cd44.filter: edgeR filterByExpr by four genotype/sort groups; min.count=10, min.total.count=15; one common universe
cd44.normalization: TMM on retained raw integer counts
cd44.multiple_testing: BH within each all-retained-gene contrast, plus BH over all three contrasts jointly for cross-contrast conclusions; marker panels show these genome-wide q-values
cd44.focus_reason: Transport the eight previously frozen IRE1 markers; source-informed targeted interpretation, not eight newly independent hypotheses
cd44.diagnostics: Library totals; retained fraction; TMM factors; rank and residual degrees of freedom; PCA of top 2000 variable logCPM genes; every mouse's paired marker differences
cd44.sensitivity: If a focus marker passes pooled three-contrast FDR 0.05, fit eight leave-one-mouse-pair-out models using the frozen retained universe; report effects/directions, never use sensitivity discoveries to replace the primary
cd44.limitations: Sorted population association; CD44 is the selection gate, not an independent validator; neither histone mechanism nor lineage fate measured. Mutation/disease state is not experimentally separable here. Raw alignment/RNA-integrity QC unavailable. This is reanalysis of the published cohort, not independent replication.
